description: CLI command runs with full DB write access when only read is needed

contextPayload.reasonSummary: The 'pd pain list' CLI command opens the state.db with read-write connection, but only needs to read. If the command crashes mid-execution, it could corrupt the database. The read-only connection mode exists but is not used.

evidence.note: new SqliteConnection(dbPath, { readonly: false }) — should be true
readonly option exists and is supported
